## Grounding

Per `CYBERSECURE_BLOCKCHAIN_GALA_HOSPITALITY_LABELOS_RECONCILIATION.md`:
`SUBSTANTIAL` overlap with `BCI-08/09` — **`TOK-01`'s title is
literally identical to `BCI-08`** ("Tokenomics Foundations"), the same
over-counting pattern already flagged for `KOR-X` (`KORA_OP_X_
RECONCILIATION.md`). Distinctness `DISTINCT_SPECIALIZATION`: token
economist/mechanism designer (game theory, simulation, stress testing,
sustainable design) is a real, distinct depth-specialization beyond
generalist blockchain engineering — same reasoning as a Mixing &
Mastering specialization beyond generalist audio production. Action:
`SPECIALIZE_EXISTING` on `BCI-08/09` — build `BCI-08/09` once as the
foundation (in `bci01_30/`, module 5), `TOK-01→15` as the

## Objectives

Teach the real economist-depth tokenomics disciplines beyond
generalist blockchain-engineering tokenomics foundations:

- Mechanism design and incentive-alignment theory (game-theoretic).
- Token-economy simulation and stress-testing methodologies.
- Sustainable tokenomics design (inflation/deflation modeling, sink/
  faucet balance).
- Cultural-asset-specific tokenomics (grounded, where cited, in
  `BCH-01`'s real cultural-asset tokenization framing — never
  presented as a CVLN-operated live token economy).

## Modules

1. Foundation cross-reference — `BCI-08/09` (built once, in
   `bci01_30/`), never re-taught here.
2. Mechanism design and incentive-alignment theory.
3. Simulation and stress-testing methodologies for token economies.
4. Sustainable design (inflation/deflation, sink/faucet modeling).
5. Cultural-asset tokenomics — cites `BCH-01`'s real framing, never
   claims a live CVLN token economy exists beyond the pedagogical
   testnet exercise.

## Assessment

A depth-specialization exam graded against real mechanism-design/
tokenomics practice, with an eliminatory check on restating `BCI-08/09`
content as if it were new, or claiming a live CVLN token economy
exists.
